title: Fairbanks Community Hub
seo_title: Fairbanks Community Hub in Springfield, MO – Nov 13
description: Fairbanks Community Hub is an arts and theater event taking place on Friday, November 13, 2026 at 10:00 AM. It will be held at the Fairbanks Community Hub, 1126 North Broadway in Springfield, Missouri. The event is open to a general audience.
